title: Content-Security-Policy without frame-ancestors
description: The Content-Security-Policy header is missing or carries no frame-ancestors directive, so nothing stops arbitrary sites from framing the page, which enables clickjacking against authenticated users.
remediation: Add frame-ancestors 'self' (or 'none' for unframed pages) to the policy. Keep X-Frame-Options during migration for older browsers.
limitation: Directive-presence only: a present-but-permissive frame-ancestors value still passes this check. Policy strength is out of scope.
